lines.trans: The elevator doors are finally closing.

grammar.en: masculine singular noun with elided article

lines.trans: Wait Mathias, hold the door for a second!
You again? What more do you want?
I am sorry to disturb you, Mathias.
Noemie has already returned her key to us.
But you, you kept yours!
We would prefer to avoid changing the locks.
Are you really afraid of my return?
It is a simple security rule here.
Here, take this office key.
Good luck running this agency alone.
Thank you Mathias, we will succeed very well.
Farewell Mathias, and godspeed to you!

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
prendre l'ascenseur = to take the elevator

examples.text: Les portes de l'ascenseur se ferment.

examples.trans: The elevator is out of order.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
changer de + noun without article: changer d'agent

examples.text: Il n'y a pas de clé.

meanings.en: fermer à clé = to lock (with a key)

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

meanings.note: tu es déjà venu? = have you been here before?

meanings.en: ça te dérange? = does it bother you?

meanings.note: je suis désolé(e) = I'm sorry; désolé! alone also works
encore une heure = one more hour
c'est moi qui gère = I'm handling it
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: merci beaucoup = thank you very much
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form
avoir peur = to be afraid; avoir peur de = to be afraid of
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Laissez la porte ouverte, s'il vous plaît.

meanings.note: laisser la porte ouverte = to leave the door open

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: je préfère = I prefer; tu préférerais = would you rather

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

rendre.gloss: to give back, to return; to make (someone happy/sad)

meanings.note: rendre service = to do a favour

examples.text: Retenez ce nom, elle est fantastique!
Je ne retiens jamais les dates.

meanings.en: to remember, to keep in mind
meanings.note: retenez ce nom! = remember that name!

examples.trans: Welcome back! / Have a good trip back!

meanings.note: être de retour = to be back

examples.text: Il y a des règles à respecter.

meanings.note: réussir à faire qc = to succeed in doing sth

examples.text: C'est notre seule chance de réussir!
examples.trans: It is our only chance to succeed!

meanings.note: changer les serrures = to change the locks

examples.text: On préférerait éviter de changer les serrures.
examples.trans: We would prefer to avoid changing the locks.

examples.text: La clé est dans la serrure.
examples.trans: The key is in the lock.

meanings.note: before the noun: le seul agent
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu veux un autographe? — Le tien?
examples.trans: Do you want an autograph? — Yours?

examples.trans: Is this my glass or yours?

meanings.en: le tien / la tienne / les tiens / les tiennes = yours (informal 'tu')

used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
